meta.subject: fixed no shared memory bug, fixed cache debug log

en.summary: This mixed commit contains a real no-shared-memory cache-interface fix: it corrects direct D-cache ready wiring and restores response tmask propagation when the shared-memory path is bypassed; it also repairs non-cacheable tag packing.
why_it_counts: The no-shared-memory path in VX_mem_unit had real interface-direction and response-mask bugs in DUT RTL.
The commit also changes non-cacheable tag packing in VX_cache and VX_nc_bypass, which affects response routing.
The debug-field reorderings are separable from the functional fixes.
disqualifiers: Several hunks only reorder debug tag fields or debug print formatting.
The commit is broader than an ideal single-bug patch, so the exact primary fault must be scoped carefully.
evidence: In the SM_ENABLE else-path of VX_mem_unit, request ready is rewired from dcache_req_if.ready = dcache_req_tmp_if.ready instead of driving ready in the wrong direction.
The same block now forwards dcache_rsp_if.tmask and drives dcache_rsp_tmp_if.ready from dcache_rsp_if.ready.
VX_cache and VX_nc_bypass explicitly remove and reinsert the NC flag bit instead of passing mismatched tag widths through the bypass path.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When an optional shared-memory or scratchpad stage is disabled, designs often short-circuit the load/store path directly into the data cache. That bypass still has to preserve handshake direction and per-lane response metadata. If request ready or response ready is wired backward, or if the returned lane mask is dropped on the bypass path, the core can stall, accept responses incorrectly, or lose which lanes a load response belongs to. This commit also fixes a secondary non-cacheable tag-packing issue, but the primary reusable injection target is the direct-path interface bug.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A configuration bypasses an optional shared-memory stage and directly forwards load/store traffic to the data cache, especially for multi-lane load responses.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Reverse the ready direction on the bypassed request or response channels and/or drop the response lane-mask field on that bypass path.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: swap producer/consumer ready assignment; omit response-mask forwarding
portability_notes: Look for an if/else configuration path that directly bridges two interfaces when a feature is disabled.
The vulnerable signals are ready/backpressure paths and per-lane metadata such as tmask, byte mask, or vector lane mask.
A secondary repository-specific bug in this commit is NC-tag packing; that can be injected separately if needed.
concrete_injection_steps: Identify the direct-bypass path used when shared memory or another optional memory stage is disabled.
Find the request ready and response ready assignments across that bypass and flip one direction back to the pre-fix orientation.
If the response carries a lane mask, remove its forwarding so the core sees default or stale lane-selection metadata.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: No-shared-memory D-cache bypass in VX_mem_unit; NC-bit tag packing in VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit fixes the SM_ENABLE bypass path by wiring ready in the correct direction and forwarding dcache_rsp_if.tmask, and also reworks NC-tag insert/remove handling so bypassed uncached traffic preserves tag meaning.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_mem_unit, the functional anchor is the SM_ENABLE else-branch around dcache_req_if.ready, dcache_rsp_tmp_if.ready, and dcache_rsp_if.tmask. In VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass, the functional anchor is the explicit insert/remove of the NC tag bit.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: In the no-shared-memory configuration, loads or stores can stall indefinitely, accept responses under the wrong backpressure conditions, or lose which lanes a response belongs to; a secondary variant can misroute non-cacheable replies because of bad tag packing.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message explicitly mentions a no-shared-memory bug and a separate debug-log fix.
The VX_mem_unit else-path is exactly the configuration used when shared memory is absent, and its ready wiring was corrected there.
The added tmask forwarding is a functional response-path fix, not a debug change.
The NC-bit insert/remove changes in VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass alter real request and response tag semantics.
notes: This is a mixed commit. The most portable and singular injection target is the no-shared-memory interface bypass bug in VX_mem_unit.
If a second fault variant is desired, reintroducing the NC-bit packing mistake in VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass is also grounded by this commit.

zh.summary: 这个混合提交中确实包含真实的 no-shared-memory cache 接口修复：它修正了直连 D-cache 路径上的 ready 连线方向，并恢复了响应 tmask 传递；同时也修复了 non-cacheable tag 打包问题。
why_it_counts: VX_mem_unit 中 no-shared-memory 路径的接口方向和响应 mask 处理存在真实的 DUT RTL 错误。
提交还修改了 VX_cache 和 VX_nc_bypass 中的 non-cacheable tag 打包，这会影响响应路由。
调试字段重排可以与功能性修复清晰分离。
disqualifiers: 若干 hunk 只是在重排调试 tag 字段或调试打印格式。
该提交比理想的单缺陷补丁更宽，因此必须谨慎界定主注入目标。
evidence: 在 VX_mem_unit 的 SM_ENABLE else 路径中，请求 ready 被修正为 dcache_req_if.ready = dcache_req_tmp_if.ready，而不是以错误方向驱动。
同一块逻辑新增了 dcache_rsp_if.tmask 转发，并把 dcache_rsp_tmp_if.ready 正确地由 dcache_rsp_if.ready 驱动。
VX_cache 和 VX_nc_bypass 显式移除/插入 NC 标志位，而不是让不匹配位宽的 tag 直接穿过 bypass 路径。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当可选的 shared-memory 或 scratchpad 阶段被关闭时，设计常常把 load/store 路径直接短接到 data cache。这个 bypass 仍然必须保持握手方向和逐 lane 响应元数据正确。如果 request ready 或 response ready 的方向接反，或者 bypass 路径丢掉了返回的 lane mask，核心就可能停死、在错误的背压条件下接受响应，或丢失“这次加载响应属于哪些 lane”的信息。该提交还修复了一个次要的 non-cacheable tag 打包问题，但主要的可复用注入目标是这个直连接口错误。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 可选路径关闭后的 cache 接口直连 bypass
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 配置关闭了 shared memory 等可选内存阶段，load/store 流量直接转发到 data cache，尤其是在多 lane load 响应场景下。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把 bypass 路径上的 request ready 或 response ready 方向重新接反，并且/或者去掉响应 lane-mask 的转发。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 交换生产者/消费者 ready 连线；删除响应 mask 转发
portability_notes: 应寻找那种在功能关闭时直接桥接两个接口的 if/else 配置路径。
脆弱点通常是 ready/背压路径以及 tmask、byte mask、vector lane mask 这类逐 lane 元数据。
该提交还包含一个次级的仓库特定缺陷，即 NC-tag 打包，可按需单独注入。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位在 shared memory 或其他可选内存阶段关闭时使用的直连 bypass 路径。
找到穿过该 bypass 的 request ready 和 response ready 赋值，并把其中一个方向改回修复前的错误方向。
如果响应带有 lane mask，则删除该字段的转发，让核心看到默认值或陈旧值。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: VX_mem_unit 中的 no-shared-memory D-cache bypass；VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass 中的 NC 位 tag 打包
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交在 VX_mem_unit 中修复了 SM_ENABLE bypass 路径的 ready 方向并补上 dcache_rsp_if.tmask，同时重做了 NC-tag 的插入/移除逻辑，使 bypass 的 uncached 流量保持正确 tag 语义。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_mem_unit 中，功能性锚点是 SM_ENABLE else 分支里的 dcache_req_if.ready、dcache_rsp_tmp_if.ready 和 dcache_rsp_if.tmask。对于 VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass，则是显式插入/移除 NC tag 位的逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在 no-shared-memory 配置下，load/store 可能无限期停顿、在错误背压下接受响应，或丢失响应所属 lane 信息；次级变体还可能因 tag 打包错误而错路由 non-cacheable 回复。
evidence_for_injection: 提交标题明确写了 no shared memory bug，以及另一个 debug log 修复。
VX_mem_unit 的 else 路径正是 shared memory 缺席时使用的配置路径，其 ready 连线在此被修正。
新增的 tmask 转发是功能性响应路径修复，不是调试改动。
VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass 中 NC 位的插入/移除改变了真实的请求和响应 tag 语义。
notes: 这是一个混合提交。最可复用、最聚焦的注入目标是 VX_mem_unit 中 no-shared-memory 接口 bypass 的缺陷。
如果需要第二个故障变体，也可以根据该提交重新引入 VX_cache/VX_nc_bypass 中的 NC 位打包错误。
